operating_constraints: Work strictly within the declared Touching Files; any out-of-bound edit fails the pipeline boundary guard.
Continuous-loop authorization: proceed task after task without confirmation prompts; escalate only on hard blockers.
Report progress in the contributor channel's assigned language; keep technical identifiers in English.
Never push to main directly; land work exclusively through the declared submission pathway.
stop_conditions: A freshly synced main no longer contains the declared Touching Files' parent directories.
Another lane's open pull request already modifies the same files with the same objective.

section_2_task_scope.objective: Standardize the 5-section deterministic instruction envelope for AI coding agents as a JSON Schema with a full valid fixture.
section_2_task_scope.problem_statement: Instruction handoffs to autonomous agents were ad-hoc prose: role, scope, policies, verification and submission contracts were re-authored per task, allowing drift between what dispatchers promise and what the pipeline guards enforce. A single deterministic envelope schema removes that drift by construction.
acceptance_criteria: Verification test suite passing with fixtures.
scripts/validate_schemas.py reports errors=0 warnings=0 across api-schemas/.
Schema cross-validates the fixture and rejects mutated negatives.

policies.statement: The Touching Files list is a hard boundary; out-of-bound edits fail CI.
Every task must satisfy the 3-tier verification contract before submission.
Every PR must reference its task issue in title or body, and the body must carry the exact Closes #N line for auto-close.
Head branches must follow the <type>/<slug> constitutional convention.

tiers.name: reflection_check
tiers.expectation: Changed paths are exactly the declared Touching Files.

tiers.name: boot_smoke_test
tiers.expectation: Both schema and fixture parse as valid JSON.

tiers.name: test_suite
tiers.expectation: Fixture validates against the schema and mutated negatives are rejected.

required_evidence: porcelain diff listing limited to the two declared files
validate_schemas.py exit code 0 with errors=0 warnings=0
negative-mutation table showing each mutation rejected
